title: Salt Lake City Bike and Brew Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Bike and Brew tour of Salt Lake City gets you out on a bike, exploring our sites with local experienced guides, and includes visits to microbreweries with opportunities for tastings! It is about 3 hours from start to finish (can be modified), and is $74/person. Sightseeing locations on our Big City Loop Tour are built into the route. We also hop from one excellent microbrewery to another, as you are guided around the City in the absolute most fun way: on bikes! 
Questions are fielded by your personal, friendly, and locally-based tour guide. Each location has food options as well, so getting a bite to eat is an easily accessible option. 

We provide bicycles, helmets, water in bottles to drink, one sample at each brewery, and of course, the guided experience.

Must be 21+ and have valid ID on your person. 

Difficulty level: Mild
